description: Paid endpoint ($0.005 per day, max $0.50 per call): archived twice-daily briefs for a date range (from/to YYYY-MM-DD, up to 366 days), each with sentiment, funding, open interest, prices, news and macro calendar. For backtesting, reviewing how the market narrative evolved, or filling a report gap. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/history
name: get_history
title: Brief archive (paid, x402) — $0.005/day (cap $0.50)

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
